jobs.prompt:
TASK: an always-on orchestrator seat for a Mac (e.g. a Mac mini): one tmux session running `claude remote-control` in a project, startable at login by launchd. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs (another session owns it); this is a standalone script run as `node tools/orchestrator-up.mjs <command>`.

Write tools/orchestrator-up.mjs (ESM, `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` first line, short header comment in the style of tools/remote.mjs, node: built-ins only). Export pure/injectable functions and run main() only when invoked directly (compare import.meta.url to pathToFileURL(process.argv[1])).
Commands (print exactly one JSON line to stdout, exit 0 on success, 1 on any refusal/error with {status:'error',code,error}):
- `up [--root DIR] [--name NAME] [--permission-mode MODE]`: ROOT defaults to cwd, resolved with fs.realpath. Session name defaults to `swarm-orch-<slug>` where slug is basename(ROOT) lowercased with every run of chars outside [a-z0-9-] replaced by '-' and trimmed of '-' (max 40 chars). A --name must match /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,60}$/ else refuse code 'orchestrator-bad-name'. --permission-mode must be one of acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, default, dontAsk, plan else refuse 'orchestrator-bad-mode'. First check tmux and claude exist on PATH (search env.PATH entries for an executable file; no `which` spawn); missing -> refuse code 'orchestrator-missing-tool' naming the tool and a hint (`brew install tmux`, or install Claude Code). Then `tmux has-session -t =NAME` (exit 0 = running): if running print {status:'running',session,root,attach:'tmux attach -t NAME'} and start nothing. Otherwise run `tmux new-session -d -s NAME -c ROOT claude remote-control --name NAME` plus `--permission-mode MODE` only when given, and print {status:'started',session,root,attach}.
- `down [--root DIR] [--name NAME]`: `tmux kill-session -t =NAME` for that exact session only (the '=' prefix forces an exact match). Never kill by pattern, never pkill/killall, never signal a PID. Not running -> {status:'not-running',session}; else {status:'stopped',session}.
- `status [--root DIR] [--name NAME]`: {status:'running'|'not-running',session,root}.
- `launchd install [--root DIR] [--name NAME] [--permission-mode MODE] [--dry-run]`: label `com.project-swarm.orchestrator.<slug-or-name>`; plist path ~/Library/LaunchAgents/<label>.plist (home injectable). Plist (XML plist 1.0, every string XML-escaped for & < > " '): Label; ProgramArguments [process.execPath, absolute path of this script, 'up', '--root', ROOT, '--name', NAME, plus '--permission-mode', MODE when given]; RunAtLoad true; KeepAlive false (tmux keeps the session alive); WorkingDirectory ROOT; StandardOutPath and StandardErrorPath ~/Library/Logs/project-swarm/<label>.log; EnvironmentVariables PATH = the directories holding tmux and claude, then /opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin (deduplicated). --dry-run prints {status:'dry-run',label,plistPath,plist} and writes nothing, spawns nothing. Otherwise mkdir the LaunchAgents and Logs dirs, write the plist with mode 0o644 (atomic: tmp file then rename), then `launchctl bootout gui/<uid>/<label>` (ignore failure: not loaded) and `launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid> <plistPath>`; print {status:'installed',label,plistPath}. uid from process.getuid().
- `launchd uninstall [--root DIR] [--name NAME]`: `launchctl bootout gui/<uid>/<label>` (ignore not-loaded), delete the plist if present; {status:'uninstalled',label,plistPath,removed:boolean}. It does NOT stop the tmux session (say so in the JSON as note:'tmux session left running; use down').
- unknown command or `--help`: print a usage line; unknown command exits 1 with code 'orchestrator-usage'.
On non-darwin, launchd commands refuse with 'orchestrator-not-macos'.
Every child process uses child_process.execFile / spawnSync with an argv array and never shell:true. Make the process runner injectable (e.g. an options object {run(cmd,args,opts)->{code,stdout,stderr}, env, home, platform, uid, realpath}) so tests never spawn real tmux/launchctl/claude.

Write tests/orchestrator-up.test.mjs (node:test, assert/strict, no real tmux/claude/launchctl): fake runner records argv; `up` when has-session fails runs exactly one new-session whose argv ends with ['claude','remote-control','--name',NAME] and passes -c ROOT; `up` when has-session succeeds starts nothing and reports running; --permission-mode is appended only when given and a bad mode or bad name refuses before any spawn; missing tmux on PATH refuses 'orchestrator-missing-tool' with no spawn (use temp dirs with fake executable files for PATH); `down` uses '-t' with '=NAME' exactly; default slug for a root named 'My Repo!' is 'swarm-orch-my-repo'; launchd --dry-run on platform darwin returns a plist containing the label, RunAtLoad true, the escaped root (use a temp root containing '&') and writes no file; launchd install writes the plist under the fake home and calls launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid>; uninstall removes it; launchd on platform linux refuses 'orchestrator-not-macos'; no recorded call ever has shell:true. Also add one test that runs the script for real with `--help` via execFile and checks exit 0.

Write docs/orchestrator-up.md: plain short words. Sections: what it is (a second always-on orchestrator, e.g. on a Mac mini, you drive from claude.ai/code or the Claude phone app via Remote Control); prerequisites (brew install tmux; Claude Code installed and logged in; run `claude remote-control` once by hand in the repo to confirm it works); start/stop/status commands with examples; attach with `tmux attach -t swarm-orch-<slug>` and detach with Ctrl-b d; start at login with `launchd install` (show --dry-run first), logs location, uninstall; safety lines: it kills only its own exact tmux session, launchd uninstall leaves the session running, the plist holds no secrets, the second seat should take only assigned items on its own branches and share the spend cap with the first. Also in docs/orchestrator-lane.md add one short 'See also' line linking [orchestrator-up.md](orchestrator-up.md) at the end; change nothing else there.
Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/orchestrator-up.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`. tests/kickoff.test.mjs is context only (it scans docs); run it too and keep it green.
